title: Absolutely Brilliant
text: Such a brilliant experience! Zara was welcoming and kept everyone having fun. Full of information and fun experience for a hen night! 🍾🎉 Thank you for everything Zara!!!
author: Amy_M

title: Fantastic and unique experience!
text: We thought that this looked a fun activity in preparation for our Barcelona wedding.   We didn't expect to have so much fun with Zara, who gave us the courage to sabre a bottle of cava with one swing for the sword.    It is a highly recommended experience and we are looking forward to trying her other experiences the next time we are back in Barcelona.
author: Nancy_L

title: You'll never need a corkscrew again!
text:
This was an amazing experience from start to ending. 
Zara makes you feel welcome from the moment you step inside of her lovely atelier.
After a brief history of the wonderful art of Sabrage, you can try it yourself and trust me you'll never want to open a bottle the boring "normal" way again!
author: T6368JYdennisv

title: Fun and original experience
text: Fun experience with excellent explanation and supervision by Zara! We went with a group of 5 friends and had a blast :-). With the right technique, the sabrage itself is quite simple. And the best part is that you have one bottle of cava to finish per person ;) it brought us in the right mood for a fun party night!
author: Steven_Vdm

title: cava sabrage and paella making class EXCELLENT
text: So much fun! Zara is a great instructor too. I always learn a lot in her classes and enjoy myself. Definitely recommend this class and her other classes.
author: 558skyej

title: One of the highlights of my trip!
text:
This was such a fun experience. Learning about the wines in the area was very interesting. Zara is such a warm and gracious hostess. We chatted the entire time and left feeling like friends. I also was able to buy a couple bottles of great wine.

On my return home all my friends could talk about was the amazing video of my new skill and wanting to see it in person. It's such a fun party, weekend, weekday, or even Friday afternoon in the office trick. I ended up buying a sabre of my own since it's been requested so often.
author: Katherine_W

title: Do not miss this experience!
text: An incredibly fun evening for our group. Do not miss this chance to learn a fun skill and drink champagne with friends.
author: Kelly J

title: Such a fun experience!
text: My husband and I were part of a nice intimate class of 7 this December and went in with really no expectations.  However, from the very beginning Zara made us feel at ease and helped the group of strangers turn fast friends.  Easily one of the best, most fun experiences we've ever had!  Highly suggest to anyone visiting!!
author: JSpin32

title: Exceptional experience - Cava Sabrage Class
text: This is a great experience - not to be missed. Zara presents with exceptional detail, fun and safety how to open a bottle of Cava with a machete! Who would have thought! Something for all lovers of wine and champagne/cava. The perfect event for corporate companies, groups or even to meet new people visiting or living in Barcelona. This would also be a great birthday gift for someone special - they so won't expect what's coming! Topped off with some Cava tasting and a keyring momento of your own cracked bottle top!
author: EliNova27

title: A fantastic experience!
text: Cannot recommend this enough for a fun and unique experience in Barcelona! One of the highlights of our trip!
author: Erin C
